agentReadProtocol: Read the newest row in Snapshot_Log.
Read Asset_Register by stable asset_id and inspect current_version, lifecycle_status, approval_status, current_master, drift_state, last_verified_at and next_action.
Read Version_History before changing any current version. Never overwrite or delete historical version rows.
Only mark a version approved when explicit human approval evidence exists.
After any asset change, update Asset_Register, append Version_History when bytes or checksum changed, append Snapshot_Log, and update last_verified_at.
